description: What changed for a developer's stack: security notes, breaking changes, model releases, new tools and news, tagged by stack (rule-based). Pass the stack tags (e.g. claude-code, mcp, supabase, vercel) and optionally a since date. 30-day window.

exclude_ids.description: Item ids already shown to the user.

lang.description: Language of returned text: en, tr, es or ru. Items without text in this language are skipped.

since.description: Only items dated on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD). Stories can arrive a day late; to avoid repeats, also pass exclude_ids.

tags.description: Stack tags. Unknown tags are reported back with the list of valid ones. Empty = all tags, last 3 days.

name: daily_brief
title: Daily stack brief
